highlights: If + Past Simple, Would have + V3
en: If the team were more careful, they would not have discarded the batch.
tr: Ekip daha dikkatli olsaydı (genel durum), seriyi (geçmişte) atmazlardı.
ipa: /ɪf ðə tiːm wɜːr mɔːr ˈkeəfʊl ðeɪ wʊd nɒt hæv dɪsˈkɑːdɪd ðə bætʃ/
trPron: if dı tiym vör mor keyrfıl dey vud not hev diskardid dı beç
tense: Mixed Conditional
commonMistake: If the team had been careful, they would discard the batch. (Wrong conditional) ❌
aiExplain: Mixed conditional, geçmişe ait bir durumu (discarded) bugünkü genel bir özellik (were careful) üzerinden kurgular.
